llm.summary: This skill is a coherent LINE sticker planning and quality-check workflow, with only purpose-aligned optional use of local sticker-processing tools.

dimensions.detail: Optional image upload, browser-side processing, and Python rembg backend use are proportionate for background removal, and the references warn not to send private images to external services without consent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill itself is markdown-only, but the README and SKILL mention optional git clone/npm install/npm run dev commands for a companion GitHub project; those are disclosed and tied to the sticker-processing purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-directed sticker creation, optional reference reading, and quality checks; no hidden role changes, prompt overrides, credential collection, or unrelated actions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background agents, privilege escalation, credential/session-store access, or automatic destructive behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe generating sticker plans, 4x3 grid prompts, Traditional Chinese copy checks, quality review, and integration guidance for a sticker slicing tool.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability

llm.guidance: Safe to install for sticker-planning use. Before running the optional companion tooling, review the referenced GitHub project and avoid putting confidential company data, account details, or private images into prompts or external image/background-removal services.
